At Alma-Ata on 24 June, in a brief reference to the German question, Khru- shchev stated that the USSR would adhere firmly to the posi- tion which he had outlined in his speeches of 15 and 21 June. Again on 26 June, in a message to East German leaders, he termed a peace treaty a "com- pulsive necessity" and pledged that the'Soviet Government would "do everything" to have a treaty .signed by the end of the year. On 28 June Khrushchev warned that reports of pro- spective Western countermeasures would not prevent the USSR from proceeding with a peace treaty. He added that the USSR was taking the necessary measures to strengthen its military posi- tion should the Western powers begin mobilization. Khrushchev stated that the USSR favored talks with the Western powers on a peace treaty, but warned the West not to hope it can deliberately protract a settle- ment. He also sought to minimize the consequences of a separate treaty by again stating "there will be no blockade of West Ber- lin of any kind" and no "re- strictions" on access, provided that interested powers reach an agreement with East Germany. Khrushchev also hinted that a second meeting with President Kennedy might be "useful," al- though he did not link this directly to the Berlin question. Bloc sources have begun to issue some assurances that while Khrushchev's statements must be taken seriously, a negotiated settlement is still possible. The Rumanian ambas- sador in Brussels stressed the firmness of Khrushchev's posi- tion on Berlin during a conver- sation with the American am- bassador. He stated that while he did not believe that Khru- shchev had in mind preventing access of the Western powers to Berlin, the access of West Germany was another matter. A Soviet Embassy official in East Berlin who often acts as a channel to convey informa- tion to the West told 25X1 that the purpose 25X1 of rus c ev s deadline was to overcome Western "delaying tactics" and to force the West into negotiations before the end of the,year. He stated that if negotiations do begin, the USSR will not conclude a peace treaty with East Germany during 1961. He reaffirmed, however, that otherwise the bloc will def- initely convoke a peace con- ference and sign the treaty this year. This line suggests that Moscow is engaging in an opera- tion similar to that of November and December 1958, when Soviet spokesmen gave private assur- ances that Khrushchev's six- month deadline was designed to exert pressure on the West, and that the period could be extended if negotiations were arranged. SECRET WEEKLY REVIEW Page 1 of 18 Approved For Release 2007/10/23: CIA-RDP79-00927A003200100001-6 Approved For Release 2007/10/23: CIA-RDP79-00927A003200100001-6 SECRET Bloc diplomats in Geneva have also inspired press re- ports to the effect that "there must be negotiations." They are quoted as taking the line that some modification in the Soviet position would be possi- ble if restrictions were placed on the transfer of nuclear weapons to West Germany and some settlement on the frontiers in Eastern Europe were accepted as final. Along this same line, East German Deputy Foreign Minister Otto Winzer said in a press con- ference that "more and more- voices" could be heard in the West advising a new agreement whereby recognition of East Germany and of the Oder-Neisse boundary would be granted in return for a new legal basis for a Western presence in Berlin. Winzer claimed that even Sec- retary of State Rusk left open such a possibility, and that this was the "most remarkable feature" of the Secretary's press conference of 22 June. A Soviet spokesman in East Berlin is reported to have taken the line that an interim agree- ment could run for more than six months, the term proposed by the USSR, if something could be arranged to halt the flight of refugees. Bloc representa- -fives are reported by the same journalists to have begun sound- ing out the possibilities for a four-power conference. While Soviet propaganda commentaries have reiterated Khrushchev's deadline, Moscow has also taken pains to deny any intention of presenting an ulLimatum. An "Observer" arti- cle in Izvestia on 24 June stressed that Western reports of Khrushchev's 21 June speech misrepresented his position by dropping the qualifying "if's" from his statement. One such example, the article contended, was that "Khrushchev said the Soviets would sign a peace treaty with the German Democratic Republic alone if the Western powers refuse to take part in putting an end to the abnormal situation" in Berlin. The pur- pose of this "distortion," ac- cording to Izvestia, was the West's desire to conceal an unwillingness to hold reasonable talks on an equal footing. A long Soviet broadcast on the same day claimed that people in Western countries were "more and more" inclined to the idea of opening negotiations with the USSR on the problems of Berlin and Germany. Disarmament The maneuvers of the So- viet representative in the bi- lateral disarmament talks with the US in Washington suggest that Khrushchev is seeking to build a case of American refusal to engage in serious negotia- tions. Soviet tactics also sug- gest that Khrushchev hopes to use the talks as a means of increasing pressure for early Western agreement to another high-level conference on Berlin and Germany by attempting to create the impression of Ameri- i can intransigence on all East- West questions. ills ' 11101 WVV LW L. ueie_%;a Ie has contended that there was no agreement between Gromyko and Ambassador Stevenson to resume multilateral negotiations on disarmament by 31 July. He stated that the USSR could not accept the American position on the pur- pose of the talks and indicated that the main task was to hold an exchange on the substance of specific disarmament plans in order to determine whether there is any basis for proceeding with further multilateral negotia- tions. He stated that the Soviet plan for complete dis- armament submitted to the UN last fall should be considered as a conference document. On 27 June, Zorin followed up this move by submitting a Soviet Government statement setting forth the "basic position" of the USSR. The statement re- views the history of prior ne- gotiations and reiterates the main points of the Soviet plan. In presenting the statement, Zarin emphasized that no suc- cess in the talks or in subse- quent negotiations was possible without consideration of specif- ic proposals by both sides. Zorin rejected the US pro- posal to add ten nations to the ten-nation committee which met in Geneva last year. His reason was that the proposed countries included states with military ties to the US. Zorin was vague, however, on the possibil- ity of adding two or three neu- trals as nonparticipating of- ficers. He merely stated that the USSR adhered to the princi- ples outlined in the talks between Gromyko and Ambassador Stevenson last March. The Geneva conference on Laos is still in the polemical stage, and both Soviet and Chi- nese representatives are de- nouncing Western control meas- ures for Laos. Soviet delegate Pushkin on 22 June stressed that the West's proposals for strengthening the International Control Commission (ICC) would mean "international control over almost all aspects of Laotian domestic affairs." He emphasized that the Laotians can determine "the form of their state system, the paths of their social, economic, and cultural development." Khrushchev as- serted that the Zurich talks proved it was possible "to get down to practical steps" lead- ing to the restoration of peace in Laos. He said chances were good for a peaceful settlement of the Laotian problem, but he reiterated the bloc's contention that the US and its allies were evading a discussion of Gromyko's 17 May proposals. Khrushchev's remarks as well as bloc propaganda commen- tary on the Zurich discussions indicate that the Communists in- tend to exploit the Zurich declaration as evidence of a significant reconciliation of the rival Laotian factions and imply that the Geneva conferees would be guilty of unwarranted interference in the progress of future talks if they sought to discuss the subjects covered in the Zurich communique. In his 26 June address at the conference Chen Yi went to some lengths in underlining the bloc's distinction between the 1954 Geneva conference and the current one. The East German diet has always been basically similar to that of West Germany, though less diversified. The quality of East German foodstuffs is in- ferior, however, and during the past ten years the East German consumer has frequently faced temporary shortages. This chronic problem now appears as a shortage of dairy products and, to a lesser extent, of meat, but in other years potatoes, vegetables, and grain have been scarce. Currently, total food supplies--measured by caloric content--are at about the same level as during the same period of 1960--perhaps slightly higher. Shortages will continue for some time. Since milk pro- duction should be at its highest level in June, the normal sea- sonal decline of milk production during the summer may intensify the problem. Institutional Changes Even without major changes in the Common Market treaty, Britain's accession would imply substantial modification of the political basis of the EEC. In part this would be a matter of adapting institutions, the most important of which are the Par- liamentary Assembly, the Com- mission, and the Council of Ministers. In the assembly, Britain could not hope to obtain more than parity of representation with France, West Germany, and Italy. This would appear to involve no insoluble problems, however, nor would Britain's participation in the Commission --the EEC's independent admin- istrative and executive body. At present, no more than two of the nine commissioners may be nationals of the same state, however, and their appointment-- by agreement among the member countries--would become a more delicate process than before. difficult problem would be ad- justment of the voting rules. Many council decisions require unanimity, but the treaty pro- vides for gradual curtailment of veto rights as the community develops. In the present six- member council, four votes con- stitute a majority in some in- stances, but provision is also made for "prescribed majorities" in which the national votes are weighted. Such procedures would be difficult to change-- even in the case of a simple majority, it will make material difference to the community's future whether four votes con- tinue to constitute a majority in a council enlarged to seven members, or whether the re- quired number is increased to five. Such nationalist-neutral- ist-isolationist advocates ap- pear a distinct minority, how- ever, in comparison with those who see Europe and North America drawn into an even closer rela- tionship. Some of the latter group are already elaborating a con- cept of an Atlantic Community, of which NATO and the new Organ- ization for Economic Cooperation and Development are the first manifestations. Jean Monnet, who perhaps more than anyone else has influenced the course of the European movement, is publicly predicting the eventual emergence of supranational Atlan- tic institutions. Conclusions While the prospect of a more efficient utilization of free-world resources is implicit in the prospect of a "better ordering" of Western Europe, there are few illusions that this potential will be either quickly or easily realized. Well over a decade has elapsed since the first moves toward European unity, and each step has encountered major difficul- ties. London's negotiations with the EEC will be difficult. They are not certain to succeed, nor is it assured that-the British electorate would approve such a basic reorientation of Brit- ain's future. In any case, the achievement of a viable Euro- pean unity will inevitably be a process in which the revising and signing of treaties are only the formalities. The process will be diffi- cult primarily because the stakes are so large. As it exists today, the Common Market --a community of some 170,000,- 000 people--has achieved rates of economic growth currently envied in the Anglo-Saxon coun- tries, and it is increasingly a dynamic economic and political force throughout the world. There is no reason why this momentum should not at least continue in a community half again as large, nor is there any reason why a unified Europe could not rank with the USSR, Communist China, and the United States among the formidable powers of the future. Within the pages of this book the single most important military figure of World War II has written the story that is destined to become the single most important record of that conflict. Here, from the hand of the Supreme Commander of the Allied forces, is the complete story of the war as Eisenhower planned it and lived it. Through his eyes you can now see the whole gigantic drama of the war -- the strategy, the battles, the moments of fateful decision. Yet this is a warm and richly personal account. No personality among all those described is more clearly defined than that of Eisenhower himself. Through his own account of the long months of waiting and planning and working, through his description of the gradual formation of the great plans for victory, through his record of the history-making hours when the machinery of battle had been launched and could no longer be recalled, you come to know this great man as no one else could describe him to you. - Jacket flap

results.title: CIA Reading Room cia-rdp88b00443r000502190001-7: QADHAFI SCOURGE OF THE THIRD WORLD
results.description: Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 QADHAFI SCOURGE OF THE THIRD WORLD Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 It should come as a surprise to no one that the leading fomenter of trouble in Africa--and in many other parts of the world--is none other than Colonel Muammar Qadhafi, dictator of Libya. Since the mid-1970s Qadhafi has stepped onto the world stage as an unwelcome actor who regularly dabbles in the internal affairs of other countries. That is hardly news to any of you. But it may come as news to learn that during the past few years Qadhafi's drive for power has taken on a new dimension as his military forces add new weapons and as his personal security service takes on increasingly daring missions of assassination and subversion. Today, Qadhafi's operations threaten perhaps two dozen countries on five continents. His agents roam the world in search of mischief, and his armies pose an ever-growing threat to Libya's neighbors. This morning I hope to tell you a little bit about Mr. Qadhafi's recent activities to give you a feel for his growing influence, and the nature of Qadhafi's quest for power. (PAUSE) As revolutions go,.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 As revolutions go, that which brought Qadhafi to power back in 1969 was not especially noteworthy. All that can be said is that it was brief, nearly bloodless, nationalist in character, and succeeded in bringing down a drowsy monarchy that threatened no one. But in the monarchy's place, Qadhafi created a totalitarian state that has the potential to unleash a savage war in Africa and the Middle East. What is more, Qadhafi has at his command the financial resources needed to build a highly militarized state and to engage in sabotage and subversion as far afield as Nicaragua and the Philippines. When Qadhafi took power in 1969 he did so as a zealot with messianic pretensions. Qadhafi sees himself as a latter-day prophet who has received a special vision of religious, social, and political truth to bring to the people of Libya. Qadhafi genuinely believes that his views will serve as a basis for eventual revolution throughout the Third World. While broadcasting his views of revolution, puritanism, unity, and militancy, Qadhafi carefully masks his personal ambitions for Libyan territorial expansion at the expense of his neighbors, and for increased personal power. I want to point out that Qadhafi's goals--both his publicly stated aims and his hidden agenda--have not changed since he came to power more than fifteen years ago. But his early and somewhat naive optimism is today clearly gone. Qadhafi now recognizes that his version of pan-Arabism .... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 version of pan-Arabism has little appeal to other Arabs. Moreover, his brand of socialism and radicalism is repugnant to most Muslims outside Libya. Qadhafi surely knows this, as he has suffered a number of setbacks politically since his aims became generally known in the early 1970s. Nonetheless, Qadhafi remains absolutely determined to change the course of history in the Middle East and elsewhere. He has never had any moral qualms about using terror and violence to achieve his ends, but with the failure of his early attempt to persuade others to follow his example, he has turned increasingly to military might and subversion. This trend has become particularly pronounced in the last few years. Since 1981 Qadhafi has turned sharply to confrontational tactics with his neighbors that make good use of his rapidly-expanding military forces. For example, Libya's army and air force currently are operating in the northern portion of neighboring Chad in an effort to continue and deepen the turmoil that has cursed that small country for many years. Other military forces are deployed opposite the border with Egypt--a major enemy from Qadhafi's point of view. Yet another major portion of Qadhafi's forces threatens Tunisia. Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 It is no secret how Qadhafi has been able to build up his military power. Qadhafi is the best cash-paying customer Moscow has for its weaponry. Now, the Soviets are not fools. They are puzzled by Qadhafi's erratic behavior--as are the rest of us. And the Soviets genuinely fear that Qadhafi's wild behavior may lead him to overstep his bounds, thus plunging the Middle East into serious conflicts that could threaten Soviet interests. But still they sell him weapons. Lots of weapons. Consider for example, the fact that Qadhafi has purchased some $20 billion worth of weapons since 1974 from the Soviets and their client states in Eastern Europe. This includes more than 2,500 tanks, 550 Jet fighters, and hundreds of self-propelled artillery pieces and surface-to-air missiles. Now, weapons like these look fine on the parade ground. But their purpose is to intimidate moderate regimes in the Third World and to inflict death and destruction on the battlefield--and they do. Another indicator of Qadhafi's aggressive intentions is his expansion of the manpower of the armed forces. Before Qadhafi seized power, Libya's army consisted of barely 8,500 men with six tanks and 90 scout cars..... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 tanks and 90 scout cars. Today, Qadhafi has more than 90,000 troops. Indeed, this figure is up by a third from estimated troop strength of 60,000 just five years ago. And still the build-up goes Egypt must now consider that a major threat to its security lies west of El Alamein. And Cairo also cannot ignore the possibility that the Libyans will force their way in through the "back door" to the South--through the Sudan. Qadhafi also possesses enough naval and air power to disrupt shipping in the Suez and Red Sea (as indeed he did in the Spring of 1984) and to disrupt resupply to Egypt from European ports across the Mediterranean. The Libyan air attack on a Sudanese radio station broadcasting anti-Qadhafi propaganda in March, 1984 demonstrates the lengths Qadhafi will go to intimidate moderate regimes as well as the types of terrorist missions he foresees for his armed forces. Algeria finds itself in the position of directing increasing amounts of attention to its southeastern border with Libya. But even more important from Algiers' perspective is Qadhafi's political threat to Tunisia. If Qadhafi is able to create or capitalize upon serious internal upheaval in Tunisia, Algeria could face a greatly increased Libyan threat along its entire eastern border. But unhappiest of all.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 But unhappiest of all are the weak states lying to the south of Libya. Chad is the obvious victim of Libyan aggression. But the Sudan and even Niger [NEE-ZHER] feel the threat of Libyan arms on their borders. As many of you know, Chad has been effectively partitioned since 1983 into a Libyan-dominated northern "state", and the recognized government of President Habre [HAH-BRAY] in the south. What is not generally known is that Qadhafi nipped off a slice of Chadian territory known as the Aozou [OW-ZOH] Strip as his price for temporarily curtailing subversion against the Government -- subversion that, I might add, he instigated. Now, we have seen this kind of bullying and threatening before. Many of you who are as old as I am vividly remember a similar megalomaniac by the name of Adolf Hitler who followed a nearly identical path. Motivated by visions of grandeur and conquest, Hitler built up a tremendous military machine while completing his totalitarian hold on Germany. Through generous doses of duplicity and terror, he used his power to strip Czechoslovakia of the Sudetenland [SOO-DATE-N-LAHND], to bully small neighbors on his borders, and to swallow tiny Austria whole. From my perspective, the parallels between Hitler's behavior in Europe and Qadhafi's behavior in Africa are too close to be a matter of mere coincidence or idle curiosity. But the story does not.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 But the story does not end here. There is an aspect of Qadhafi's international behavior that even Hitler did not emulate. And that is Qadhafi's use of "hit teams", subversion, and terrorism on a scale unprecedented in this century. Qadhafi's program of terror, fear, and subversion has reached countries hundreds or even thousands of miles from Libya's shores. These include, to name but a few, Italy, Greece, West Germany, France, Great Britain, Ireland, Spain, Ghana, Mauritania, Zaire, Uganda, Saudi Arabia, the Philippines, Brazil, the island republics of the West Indies, Nicaragua, El Salvador, and...yes, the United States. Let me give you just a few of the more spectacular Libyan plots that have come to light in the last two years or so. *In June 1983, the Libyan envoy to Jordan defected and revealed Qadhafi's plan to use missiles to destroy the aircraft carrying King Hussein. *One of Qadhafi's most publicized efforts was an attempt to kill Chadian President Habre with a briefcase bomb in September 1984. *As indicated during .... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 *As indicated during the shootout last year in London, Libya abused diplomatic privilege by storing large quantities of arms and explosives at its diplomatic establishments. *The FBI last spring disrupted Libyan plans to conduct attacks on Libyan dissidents living in the U.S. *During the past two years, Libyan terrorists have killed or wounded a number of dissidents in Europe. Tripoli also was responsible for a series of bombings in the UK which injured 25 people in London and Manchester in spring 1984. *In March 1984, Tripoli used one of its Soviet-supplied TU-22 bombers to attack a dissident radio station outside of Khartoum, Sudan. This was followed in July 1984 by Libya's mining of the Red Sea. *Last May Egyptian officials intercepted a truck loaded with explosives that reportedly were to be used in a Libyan-backed plot to blow up the U.S. Embassy in Cairo. In the past, Qadhafi's.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 In the past, Qadhafi's fear of U.S. retaliation has made him reluctant to target U.S. personnel directly in terrorist operations. This reluctance may be diminishing, however. *Qadhafi has publicly warned that he would expand terrorism to the U.S. in retaliation for what he claimed was the U.S. inspired attempt to attack his headquarters in May 1984. *Moreover, Qadhafi and his principal deputy, Jallud, [JAH-LOOD] have made five major speeches this year alone extolling the use of suicide terrorists in operations against U.S. personnel in Lebanon. Now, I could go on and on with specific examples to document Qadhafi's numerous outrages against other nations and against international law in general. But I think I have cited enough examples to make the case. The point is that Qadhafi has repeatedly--let me emphasize that word--repeatedly demonstrated that he is unconstrained by accepted standards of international conduct. He has repeatedly employed tactics of assassination and violence not only against Libyan exiles and .... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Libyan exiles and opponents, but against foreign leaders such as President Mubarak [MOO-BAHR-AHK], President Habre, and former Sudanese President Nimeiri, King Hussein, and Iraq's President Saddam Hussein. He has established terrorist training camps on Libyan soil, financed known terrorists, provided them weapons and documentation, and given terrorists safe-haven following their missions. This latter activity--the training and dispatching of terrorist goons--has the potential for becoming an even greater threat to international stability and order than does Qadhafi's purely military build-up which I mentioned earlier. This is basically for two reasons. First, with continued recruitment and training of terrorist operatives, Qadhafi can expand his "reach" to corners of the globe he could not otherwise hope to touch. Second, the terrorists he has trained now are training others. In this way, the evil that Qadhafi has brought into the world now is reproducing itself and spreading like a virus throughout Africa and the Arab World to Europe, the Americas, and East Asia. Unlike the build-up of military forces, the employment of terrorists is relatively cheap and quick. And, in the Middle East, it is not hard.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 it is not hard to recruit or train fanatics of many stripes to carry out terrorist acts. Furthermore, terrorist teams are small, highly mobile, hard to detect, and harder still to defend against. Qadhafi probably hopes that terrorist units can be employed to destabilize his enemies, particularly Egypt and Jordan, thereby precipitating a revolution or--at a minimum--weakening the military and security defenses of those countries. Qadhafi's goals in Western Europe and the Americas probably are somewhat less ambitious, but are nonetheless serious. By fomenting trouble, for example, in the island republics of the West Indies, Qadhafi probably hopes to divert the attention and resources of the U.S. and France away from the Middle East and Africa. Qadhafi's objectives in Africa are more obvious. By methods both crude and bold, Qadhafi seeks to make himself the paramount ruler on the continent. If Qadhafi had his way, both Western and Soviet influence in Africa would be eliminated and replaced by his own stark, narrow, ethnocentric views which blend socialism, a maverick version of Islam, and xenophobia. Tripoli would become, in effect, the political capital of Africa, and Qadhafi its prophet and master. Let me go back.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Let me go back for a moment and pick up on the Soviet thread in this Libyan tangle. I mentioned earlier that the Soviets are as puzzled as we are about some of Qadhafi's actions. And they are. And, I mentioned that--despite their well-placed qualms about Qadhafi's goals--they continue to sell him mountains of sophisticated weapons. And so they do. Why? (PAUSE) The Soviets look at Qadhafi through two sets of eyes. As veteran subversives themselves, they recognize in Qadhafi one of "their own." Qadhafi's activities are almost entirely directed against the democracies of Europe and the Americas, and their allies among the moderate states of Africa and the Middle East. These are the very same countries that the Soviets are seeking to weaken or destroy. If Qadhafi can do the work for them, so much the better. The icing on the cake, of course, is that--not only is Qadhafi actively aiding and promoting the Soviets' long-term strategy-- he is paying for the privilege! In hard currency, at that. W.C. Fields once.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 W.C. Fields once said "Never give a sucker an even break." The Soviets are no fools. But they recognize in Qadhafi a useful crackpot who repeatedly squanders billions of dollars of Libya's precious oil money on Soviet weapons, and then turns those weapons against the very countries that are targets of Soviet subversion. Why, indeed, should the Soviets give Qadhafi an even break? The Soviets should be grateful to Mr. Qadhafi. Were it not for Qadhafi's kind assistance, the Soviets would have to spend years building up legions of spies and fifth columnists in many countries, carry out the whole range of risky terrorist and subversive activities themselves, and then supply--at their own cost--the billions and billions of dollars' worth of weapons that have been channeled through Qadhafi's arsenals to other countries. Maybe Lenin was right when he talked of "useful idiots" who unwittingly serve the cause of the Bolshevik Revolution. Qadhafi certainly fits the description. But let me touch on one other thing before I close. Like war, fear makes strange bedfellows. Qadhafi's rapid military build-up, his political blustering over the air waves, and especially his wide-ranging bands of thugs and murderers is getting a lot of people worried. Not just on Pennsylvania Avenue. But in places like Algiers, Cairo, Tunis, Paris, Kinshasa, and Bonn. In short, if Qadhafi.... Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 Approved For Release 2011/01/10: CIA-RDP88B00443R000502190001-7 In short, if Qadhafi continues his current reckless path to power, more and more countries will come to recognize him for what he is--a major threat to peace in the Middle East. And, if he continues to bully and threaten, sooner or later his smaller and weaker neighbors will Join together to protect themselves from Qadhafi's depredations. Qadhafi, like Hitler, will last only so long as his many victims remain divided and fearful. Qadhafi has repeated Hitler's error of mistaking for weakness the restraint of moderate countries like Egypt. He looks cynically on international resolutions condemning him for aggression as being only so many scraps of paper. Could history repeat itself? Only time will tell. results.description: rDeclassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400~4\40007-0 I F( U kA_" FBIS-NES-90-056 22 March 1990 INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS I Further on World Islamic Popular Command Congress Al-Qadhdhafi's Address 19 Mar LD2103153190 Tripoli Television Service in Arabic 2214 GMT20 Mar 90 [Speech by Libyan leade Mu'ammar Al- adIvAaf at the World Islamic Popular ommand Congress in Tri- poli on 19 March-recorded] [Excerpts] In the name of God. Brothers, we welcome you once again at your own house and in your own country and among your brothers. [passage omitted[ There is a deliberate intent to terrorize this nation. There is real opposition to its future. There is a crusade campaign-which we can call the 10th crusade being led by the United States. When we say the United States of America, we do not mean the United States in which there are the blacks, the whites, the red, the Arabs, the Jews, etc., but we talk about the crusading establishment which monopolizes authority in the United States. con- trols the military machine, has the power of wealth, blackmails the world, intimidates the world, and uses the capabilities of the United States according to the objec- tives of this capitalist gang. It is allying itself with counterparts in Britain and Europe and wants to create instruments for itself and regimes similar to its own, that represents its type of capitalists, conspirators, lackeys, exploiters. It tries to protect them with its inteligence services, bases, and armies in order to control the entire globe. As it is clear to you, we are now living within a ring in the chain of historical conflict between us and this evil and hated power which is antagonistic toward us. In fact, it represents the work of the devil on earth. The so-called United States of America and its capitalist, imperialist gang-its allies-which it controls, in fact embodies the devil on earth and wants to [words indistinct]. A Muslim ruler who comes under the influence of America in fact becomes a polytheist because he has knelt before America and paid a pilgrimage to the White House. Visits to America and meetings with the American President by Muslim rulers amount to a pilgrimage to the American White House, polytheism. A Satanic country like that is not to be visited: no relations should be established with it, and it is forbidden [haram] for an Islamic country to establish relations with the govern- ment of America and its allies. The break between us and them should be permanent and decisive. We do not need them. They need our raw materials and our consumer markets. They have trans- formed us into a consumer market for their trivial products. They want these markets and these raw mate- rials and exploit these possibilities in their own interest. They even carry out medical experiments on our bodies, our sons, and our kin when the latter go for medical treatment to them. We are not in need of American nuclear power stations. We do not need American sky- scrapers; we do not need the so-called Statue of Liberty. We do not need them. This country where you are meeting today-which is the heart of the Islamic world-the Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jama- hiriyah-declares that it does not need America, nor Britain, nor Germany, nor any of these crusading states. We can live forever without even glancing at where America and its Satanic allies are situated. They boycotted us for the past 20 years. We lost nothing. We welcome such a boycott so that we can lock up our market to their trivial products, which have corrupted our food, clothes, manners, and even our stomachs. If we are serious brothers about jihad and about the action which deserves to be seen by God-if we are actually serious, it is inevitable that from this place we should go to our countries and call for comprehensive boycott of the forces of evil on earth. We should lay siege to them. We should not allow them to blockade us. We are the ones who should blockade them. They manufacture the consumer goods and need naive people to buy them in order to cat, wear, drink and use such goods. They need these raw materials. We should prevent them from exploiting them. Peace with America'? It is a deceit and hypocrisy, and hypocrites are doomed to the lowest level of hell. There should be no embassy for either America nor Britain nor Germany nor all the Satanic forces in any Muslim country. Nor should any aircraft of the Satanic forces be allowed to land or any ship to anchor in the territory of Islam; it is a disgrace. Brothers, you certainly recall the Sharif Husayn-British McMahon negotiations. Sharif Husayn might not have been personally so, but at least the Islamic atsmophere and the Islamic spirit prevailing at the time, during the First World War, did not allow a crusader to set foot on the Arabian Peninsula. Consequently, the historic well- known Husayn-McMahon talks were held on the Red Sea. Why? Because McMahon was a crusader and the ordinary Muslims in the streets would not allow him to set foot on the Arabian Peninsula. Those were historic negotations which altered the course of the World War I and influenced the World War 11 and affected the history of the world. These talks were held at sea not only because Husayn was a Muslim, but also because the ordinary Muslim in the street would stone McMahon if he get hold of him, for he is a crusader not allowed to set foot in the holy land. They decided to turn Indonesia to Christianity after 40 years. The Philippines was Muslim and they turned it Christian by force. Africa was Muslim, which they turned into Christian. We are living, as I have already said. in a battle against the 10th crusader campaign led by the United States of America and its Satanic allies. I wish to tell, brothers, that out of the experience of 21 years of political-economic-social struggle with the far Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 and the near, the continents of the world and its super and minor powers and others, and out of all interactions between us and the rest of the world, I assure you, and especially many of you who have not reached power and are still living in the street with the masses or live in the mosque-I assure you that what is needed is the control of the street and not the seat of power because the seat is worth nothing. I stress that the world has changed. Were the people of the Soviet Union to demonstrate and reject the emigration of the Khazars [Jews] to Palestine, the government of Moscow would be incapable of pursuing this course. If we could persuade the American people to stand against the policy of its government in this or that field, then it would have no support in carrying out aggressive action against this or that field. I mean their parties and organizations. Brothers, if you think that coming to power will lead to the rule of Islam and the victory of Islam, you are wrong. Rulers should now become naught [asfar'ala al-shimal]. Rulers without the masses-this is the era of the masses, as the Green Book-whose contents are derived from the reality of the world, the history of peoples and their struggles, the suffering, and the aspirations and hopes of mankind-says. This experience is summarized in the Green Book. The Green Book is not made up by an individual: It is a collection of these conclusions, of these historical results. This is the era of the masses. If we want to boycott America, we should not have ambitions for power: we should be in the street in order to boycott it. Rulers are now unable to boycott America. Muslim rulers are unable to boycott America. Statements against America and in support of Libya have been issued, but because these statements were made by governments, they did not mention America by name. The statements said: We condemn aggression, we condemn provocation, we sup- port the Libyan people. You support it against whom? The aggression is by whom? They are unable to say America! When Russia wanted to court America, it ordered all the communist states in the world to avoid the word America in their official statements. We went to visit communist countries, to talk to them- communist countries in Africa, and elsewhere; we pro- posed joint communiques saying we condemn American imperialism and so on, but they said: No! Cross out the word America; we are against imperialism. What impe- rialism? They said: Imperialism. [words indistinct] Orders! Because Russia wanted to court America and did not want to mention it by name. By that I mean that if you want to get power in order to establish Islam, then I tell you that this is wrong. If we are in power, then we should leave it for the street! A government cannot order a worker in a cafe not to give coffee to McMahon, or to a crusader, or to Baker or anyone of those crusaders. But we in the streets can close the cafe in his face. He can sit down and we would not even provide him with water or services. Our Muslim workers should not.give their services in ports, airports, FBIS-NES-90-056 22 March 1990 or hotels to any crusader from these wicked powers. We who wear the clothes of America, we in the streets, we the masses-the masses of Islam-we are the ones who are clad in the clothes of America, Italy, Germany, or France. If we become convinced and took off these clothes, they would be left unsold and accumulate in the streets. [passage omitted]. If we actually wanted to create an Islamic revolution, and an Islamic reawakening as well as progress, and a new Islamic renaissance, and change the current course of history and restore some sense to these tyrannical forces and make them seriously take this nation into account, we should control the street and not the regime-we should now leave the seats of power to those who want to sit on them-because the latter are either nothing or are sick-as those who want the seat of power are sick as you cannot do a thing with that seat, then you must convince the man in the street after that. Therefore we are in the street; we are the ones whose friendship will be sought by those sitting on the seats of power. He will beg the others to boycott America, for example. So long as we are the workers, we will do so even without an order from the ruler; we will boycott America. [passage omitted] If America is not pleased with a government in the Islamic world, it will change it; it will make it fall. If America is not satisfied with the Muslim masses, what can it do? Nothing. It will submit. Can it change a people and exchange it with another? This is impossible. America can change a ruler. If a ruler stands against America, America may invade his country, as it has four million soldiers; it can send one million to any country. It has intercontinental missiles; it has atomic bombs; it has chemical bombs; it has bacteriological bombs. It can change any regime. But it cannot change a people; it cannot alter a nation. It cannot annihilate a nation. A ruler can be removed. The rulers now are puppets-rulers in the Islamic world now are puppets in the hands of Moscow and then Moscow abandoned communism and therefore these rulers have become suspended; belonging neither to this or that side. The rest who follow capitalism, America, and the crusade comply with the orders of these but fear you-they fear the street; they fear the mosque; they fear the school and the college, as well as the workshop, and the field. Therefore, we should have a presence in the locations from which, if we say to hell with America. then that will be exactly what we say and mean, and if we say no then it will be no. If you reach power then you will become a prisoner of that power. Had I been a president, or a king or an amir, I would not have been able to lead demonstrations in the street; I would.not have been able to fight side by side with the fighters and support the liberation movements and establish an international leadership and center for these movements and pay the price for all that by having American bombs fall on me and an American attack on Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 FBIS-NES-90-056 22 March 1990 INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS my country and American provocations against and blockade of my country; had I been a ruler, I would not have been able to do that. [passage omitted] Had I been a ruler I would not have been able to say that America should he boycotted and the forces of evil should be boycotted; I would not have been able to say that they are Satanic forces, and want to be treated as gods; I would not have been able to say that America is the Satan on earth. [passage omitted] We by ourselves and without the police call on the people to refrain from wrong-doing and uphold right-doing. If a policeman hits my car and damages it and tells me to go and perform prayers, then this is wrong. My conscience is my policeman. [passage omitted] The Koran does not mention a government, nor an army, nor a cabinet, nor parliament; it does not even mention a party. The party of God are the Muslims; the Muslims are the party of God [hizballah.]; non-Muslims are the party of Satan. We have declared that the Islamic nation is the party of God. America, the Israelis, and their allies are the party of Satan. Islam is a creed of the masses. It talks of the masses, not of the rulers. It did not say: Send representatives of yours to walk round the Kaaba. Call unto people for pilgrimage and they will come from all corners of the world, on foot or riding. [passage omitted] There is no army in Islam. There is militant [mujahid] people, armed people. And they conduct their affairs by mutual consultation [Koranic quotation]. That means all Muslims must consult each other on the conduct of their affairs. There is no representation; it did not say their affairs must be left to their representatives. He said: And they conduct their affairs by mutual consultation. Now we see a falsification of this principle; they set up a council and call it the council of consultation [majlis al-shura]. Are they falsifying the Koran and lying about Almighty God? God knows the meaning of shura. The shura means that all the masses get together and carry out mutual consultation and decide what they want. It is not a council; the council means representation. You can see this clear falsification. As if setting up the council of consultation is enough and we have settled our account with God, the Almighty, and we have satisfied Him by following the Koran. They complain: Why do we quarrel with them when they already have a council of consultation? Has God speci- fied a council of consultation? [passage all colors equally and does not recognize racist discrim- ination. There are also the red Indians, the underdogs, and Islam stands by the underdogs. Islam, brothers, is the religion of the masses. Islam, brothers, is the religion in the Jamahiriyah. Consequently, we could not have a system other than the collective one. [passage omitted] Islam is the religion of the group. We are a group in prayers, a group in pilgrimage, a group in struggle. We want to go to the streets, brothers. I would like you to take matters seriously, and to understand that had there been any benefit in rule, I would have been the first one who remained a president of republic, or king. I had ousted a king, and my colleagues could have appointed me king in his place, because rule is worthless. We have to oppose rule. We have to ridicule hired, insignificant, and puppet rulers. This Islamic nation has become a nation of sheep. Imagine: a number of cadets were on board a bus-cadets from the Let its stand with Muslims in Bulgaria and any other place, the Philippines for instance. Yes, we have the funds. The only sacred battle is recovering Arab oil from America and the Israelis. Billions of Islamic funds and oil are in Jewish and American factories. Is this Islam? Are these Islamic governments? Is this the Arab ruler? This is a heretic, a renegade. We can not be Muslims if we are hypocrites. You go to the ruler and tell him: You are our master. How could he be your master if his master is American or a Jew? He has given himself to the enemies of religion, and those of the nation. We have nothing to do with him. He is despised, cursed, filthy, and we should not ask him anything. We should achieve what we want in the street against his will, and that of his American and Israeli masters. There are one billion Muslims. Do you think that this billion is under the authority of rulers? This billion is feared by the hireling Islamic governments. Conse- quently, this Islamic leadership should mobilize one billion Muslims against the Israelis, or the Americans, or anything else. [passage omitted] I discovered that these Arab regimes prevent their tele- visions from broadcasting the uprising. I thus decided to collect all the recordings of the atrocities taking place in Palestine against women and children by the Israelis who are backed by America and its allies, and:to distribute Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 FBIS-NES-90-056 22 March 1990 INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS 5 them all over the Islamic world. I want them to reach the streets and the billion Muslims, not the rulers. We will distribute videotapes all over the Islamic world if the atrocities by the Israelis against women and children in Palestine, which are hidden by Muslim rulers in the Islamic world for fear of America and the Israelis. This initiative will be financed by Libya, before you manage to collect one billion dinars from Muslims to spend on your action. I asked citizens from Arab and Islamic countries: Have you ever seen such ugly events? They answered: Where? I said: on television. They replied: not at all. Only Libyan television put out such news reports. But television services in the Islamic world-beginning with the Arab homeland-do not do so, as rulers ban the broadcast of such pictures. America bans the broadcast of such pic- tures. On orders from America and the Israelis, they forbid the broadcast of such pictures. I regretted that the fracturing of arms and legs with sticks and in front of photographers-the fracturing of arms and legs of women, youth, and children-are banned from the Islamic world, to the Islamic popular masses. We do not need a radio or power; it suffices for us to produce a videotape and distribute it to one billion people; we should concentrate on this point because it is important, because it is the starting point on this action. If we want to establish a real Islamic renaissance and unity and wage a real jihad, then we should not think about power at all. [passage omitted] America and the crusaders and the Jews are now laying down the laws. They lay down the law and call it international law. They mold human rights in the shape they want. The right of man is that he lives assured about himself without fearing missiles and without being threatened by fleets; without fearing that bombs may fall on his head while he is asleep; it is his right to determine his destiny by himself and enjoy the rewards of his sweat and toil, and not to give up this reward in favor of a money-lender who charges interest, or to exploiters or to the wealthy. This is not recorded in the Bill of Rights which America laid down-or as one of us said, the bill which America uses to justify the slaughter of others. As you-a Muslim-say: "In the name of God" when you slaughter a sheep or chicken or cow, America says the Bill of Rights when slaughtering a nation. [passage omitted] Is this democracy? Democracy is what we are estab- lishing: Demo-Karasi [chairs], people on chairs, so that it can be translated. Democracy is what Islam taught them, the religion of the collective, shura. Their affairs are a matter of consultation among them. [Koranic verse] Not a consultative council; collective consultation. These armies, these Islamic armies cannot resist America or even the Israelis; otherwise, why did they not liberate Palestine or even Jerusalem? What will defeat America and Israel is the weight of one billion Muslims, it is jihad. We want to mobilize the masses; we can liberate Pales- tine with knives! [passage omitted] [25-second break in transmission] We are indeed made up of [words indistinct] and we should not ignore it in the same way that Marxism ignored nationalist work. They said: We have found you a new religion, that is, communism; that all peoples from Europe to Asia should be organized within this new religion; and that all peoples should abandon their nationalities, languages, and heritages. This system has finally proven its failure: an Azerbaijani is an Azerbai- jani because his nationality is Azerbaijani; an Armenian is an Armenian, a Lithuanian is a Lithuanian and a Russian is a Russian! Ignoring nationalism will lead to peril. Ignoring nationalism leads to perdition in the end; one should not ignore nationalism. Now, the Soviet Union has recognized that nationalism is a fundamental factor, and one cannot integrate peoples of various languages and nationalities in one suitcase and say: That is it, the problem is solved. No, this should be a free choice. The Ottoman empire ignored Arab, Persian, Serbian, and Turanic [Turkish political movement of the late 19th century] nation- alism, and it was thus been torn apart and finished. It thought that the Ottoman origin of the empire was enough to integrate these nations of various nationalities and languages. We must draw lessons from these great historic experi- ences. When the Abbasid empire in Iraq ignored Persian nationalism, it was finished, and when the Ottoman Empire ignored Arab nationalism, it was finished, and when the sacred Christian empire ignored the Latin, Roman, and other nationalities, it came to an end, and when the Soviet Union, Communism, and Marxism ignored nationalities and religions, it came to an end. We do not want to build something that had been tested in the past and collapsed. We must recognize that this nation is composed of a number of nationalities, and we must respect them. But we are brothers in Islam, brought together by islam. And if one of the nationalities that constitute the Islamic nation is wronged and oppressed, all the other islamic nationalities would come to its help and stand by it. [passage omitted] Some are defending one another in the name of defending democracies, the free world or NATO mem- bers. They do not speak the same language. [passage omitted] They are nations of different languages and races, but to defend one of them, they would all rush in to do so in the name of the defense of democracies, the free world, the Western world, the capitalist world, the colonialist world, or NATO members. In the final anal- ysis, they are a diabolical force, united by the Satan, by evil, rancor, racism, hated, and desire to control and destroy, and therefore, this force does not want to see the weakening of one of its component parts. We are the angels and they are the devils. It is a struggle between good and evil. In their languages, they know the existence of good and evil, but they cannot be good at all. They are evil itself, but there is no one to resist them. This devil must be stoned. Muslims who do the stoning [in Mecca] should stone the Zionists in Palestine. Muslims who throw one stone on pilgrimage day should take seven stones and go to Palestine. This is the holy struggle, the stoning, the true pilgrimage in this period. What does it mean to go and throw seven stones during the pilrimage? This we should do when in peace and security, and we want to carry out our rites as dictated by God, and when there is no other devil apart from this statue [in Muna]. [passage omitted] But when the devil exists in Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, the Gulf of Sidra, and in America, why do we not stone him, instead of this statue symbolizing it? The devil itself exists. This is true pilgrimage. If what we are saying was spread among the billion Muslims, there would a be an Islamic cultural revolu- tion, and a true spiritual revolution, and they would know that we are on the right path. [passage omitted] Our consultation takes place in mosques. We have decided to transform mosques into people's Islamic councils of consultation. From these mosques we say: To hell with America; we say: We declare holy war; and we say: Let us march, and so on. No one could ever prevent us from that. This is Islamic will. [passage omitted]. But I declare that I am not in power, I am in the street with the people's masses leading the people's revolution. [passage omitted]. As for me, no one can complain against me by law, because the Libyan state is not officially responsible for what I say. I do not have any legal, political, or administrative authority within the Libyan state. I lead the revolution. I may be in Libya, in the Sudan, in Tunisia, in Nicaragua or anywhere else; I may be in the Philippines or Indo- nesia. If any of you becomes a ruler, he should leave the popular leadership, because this is an Islamic popular leadership which wants to mobilize one billion Muslims. A ruler shall not be involved with us in this mobilization. A ruler shall be involved in diplomacy. [passage omitted] We should declare that a Muslim ruler is forbidden to go to America or to the Great Satan on a visit. Visiting the White House is blasphemy. You are not allowed to visit the Ka'bah and visit the American White House; this is blasphemy. Why? What does the American White House mean? What is the policy of the White House? The destruction of the world; hatred toward Islam; it is a crusade. How can you go to the capital city of the crusade, and receive instructions from it and then say that you are a Muslim and visit the Ka'bah. You would be stoned if you were found in the Ka'bah. If someone visits the American White House and then comes to the Ka'bah, he sould be stoned. This is because he is unclean. Our house should be cleansed of the unclean. [passage omitted] If you withdraw into your shells, are afraid, keep silent, and become hypocrites, you will pay a double price. They will massacre you. The rulers will, as well as America and Zionism. All these are in your path, holding their knives. They are currently sharpening their knives to kill you. Resistance! Resistance! The massacre is in the offing, but if you resist, there is hope that you win, and prevent the slaughter. If you do not resist, you will be massacred in your sleep. We did not go to America. We were asleep at 0200 hours, and they let the biggest bombs fall on us. One hundred seventy NATO aircraft were over our homes and our children during their sleep. They said it was in the name of human rights, in the name of the free world, and in the name of peace. Imagine how peace can be. It is arbitrary in every way. [passage omitted] Gentlemen, if we agree on what we are saying here, it should be included in the draft charter, not the charter as it is now, and the internal regulations. [passage omitted] For this is frightening for the crusade and Zionism and their hirelings to see the setting up of an Islamic com- mand to stir up the street, without any links with government; a command that would dwarf rulers and trivialize power. It would not at all look toward the seats of power, leaving them in the dustbins. This is grave. They want confrontation; they want us to seek power so that we may be eliminated, or attain power so that we may emptied of any substance, because we would be submitting to laws made by America. If you were a government, you would be forced to sign an American-made human rights convention; otherwise you would be considered outside the international com- munity. But we can express human rights as seen by God, by Islam, as we see them ourselves. You would be forced to obey international law, you would be forced to obey an American law called international law, if you were a ruler. It would be a great thing to take to the streets and declare a divorce with the government and power, its seats and its elections. We would have nothing to do with it. These people deal with America, and we wash our hands of them. This would be a great thing. I am after these governments that you do not want, the reactionary, hireling, pro-colonial and pro-Zionist governments. Their end is not in a confrontation with them; it is by giving them the lie, trivializing them, transcending them to the street, and leaving them aside. If such govern- ments provide us with services in drains, telephones, or roads, all right, but we do not want this. Because if we build a plant, it is destroyed by America; if we build a block of flats, it is destroyed by Zionism; if we construct a vehicle, they cut off supplies of spare parts to us, and Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 Declassified and Approved For Release 2012/01/19: CIA-RDP05-01559R000400440007-0 FBIS-NES-90-056 22 March 1990 INTERNATIONAL AFFAIRS they boycott us. No, we do not want... [changes thought] Who said we want factories, hotels. We want to do without these things. We want to turn to the land and eat off it; we do not want distilled water, neither do we want Evian water or anything else. We want to drink rainwater, water from wells, from cisterns, but we want to live in peace and freedom, in our land, in our homes, and our presence and that of those allied to America; its embassies, its citizens, its tourists, products, its various means. They must be completely boycotted by the ordinary man, and we declare in the mosque that it should not be permitted by religion to drink or eat [American products], or shake hands or dealt with an American, because he represents Satan on earth. America must be stoned, even though this is not cur- rently the time of the rites of stoning [in the pilgrimage, Muslims perform the rites of rajm, the stoning of statues representing Satan]. Zionism also must be stoned. America is lulling us with talk about its going to resolve the problem of Palestine. This is ridiculous. The man called Baker is pretending to be called Abu-Bakr just to deceive Muslims. They say: This man is called Abu- Bakr; an American. He has presented a ten-point plan saying that he is going to resolve the Palestinian problem. How can the Palestinian question be resolved by this Baker? The problem of Palestine will be solved by the billion Muslims marching on it. Would America, which created Israel and is providing the Israelis every day with the means of destruction, solve the problem of Palestine? Is it as we say, the guards are the thieves? Every day they confuse our thoughts; when will the meeting between the Palestinians and the Israelis take place? And when will the international conference con- vene? And when will the Baker plan succeed? And when will America undertake mediation? All these are meant to confuse us and deceive us so as to enable the emmi- grant Jews to settle with American funds and complete their training and arming. remains and we want to occupy it and search for these remains and let tourists visit these archeological sites. Look what they are saying; do you think they will withdraw from the West Bank? It is impossible. Their map stretches from the Euphrates to the Nile and to Mecca, and this is only Greater Israel, while the rest of the Islamic world should be under its control and hege- mony assisted by nuclear force. It is manufacturing nuclear, bacteriological, and chemical bombs, while the Arabs and the Muslims must not do so, neither Pakistan nor Afghanistan nor Libya nor Iraq. They must produce neither nuclear nor bacteriological nor chemical bombs. Why? Because this contravenes the scheme which America wants to succeed, namely Jewish control over the entire Islamic world. They believe, brothers, that in the active world there exist only two: the Jews and the Christians. The Christians have the industrial power and the currently advanced world. The Jews should be their allies in the eastern part [of the world], with the mineral ores, the excellent climate, the sunshine, the strategic passes, and the spiritual places from Mecca to Jerusalem. All of which must be under the control of the Jews, protected by the Christian world, as long as we remain naive. The story is that Christ was an Israeli, and as we are followers of Christ, then consequently we are your fol- lowers. The Christians follow an Israeli prophet. Christ is an Israeli, a Jew. Christianity is Judaism. Christianity is Judaism-two sides of the same coin. On this side, we have Moses, and on the other we have Jesus. But it is all Israelite-Judaism. It is an alliance between the crusade and Judaism-why is there such an alliance and sym- pathy now with the Israelis in Palestine by the Christian forces? Because the'religion is one. But this can only be accomplished with the removal of the Islamic presence, and before that the Arab presence. Both the Arab and Islamic presence is removed, and then there will be a vacuum to be filled by Judaism in alliance with Christi- anity. The world will then be stable until Doomsday; they will act according to this in preparation for the descent of Christ. How can Christ come back while we-Jews and Christians-are separated, while Christ is the prophet of us all? He is Jesus and is coming for the Israelites. Christians-those who are now called Chris- tians-adopted the religion of Jesus. How can Jesus come back and find us disunited? This is what they say. How sad-as they say-to see Jesus-the awaited Jesus-come back while Judaism and Christianity are wide apart? They say: No; Jesus is the prophet of us all, and when he comes we should have prepared the earth for his descent and removed the barbaric and savage Arabs and hateful Islam; they say that Muhammad is a charlatan and not a prophet. They say that he is a poet, a cleric, and a wizard; they say that the Koran is the law of Hammurabi. They discussed that with me when I was at a military school in Britain in 1966-before the revolution. They discussed this with me, regardless of who I was-whether Mu'ammar al-Qadhdhafi or not- just somebody from overseas, and a Muslim. [passage omitted] This is nonsense. There is no solution. There will be no West Bank nor Gaza nor any other place. They have ambitions other than from the Euphrates to the Nile. Zionism and America want to occupy the Arab world and the Islamic world. They are not in retreat. They are advancing, and are planning how to occupy Jordan, Syria and Sinai. They are planning now and training to go back to Sinai. They want to occupy the land stretching from the Nile to the Euphrates and Mecca and al- Madinah. They say: You Arabs claim that Jerusalem belongs to you and not to the Jews; we claim the Ka'bah because it was built by Abraham, and al-Madinah al- Munawwarah is a Jewish city from which you have expelled us. Banu Nazir and Banu Quraydhah [two Jewish tribes which lived in al-Madinah al-Munawwarah before and during early years of Islam] was lived have there ee and it is their city. I will he a brother among you, and there will be a collective leadership [working] according to Islam [words indistinct], and we will all go together. Leaders of the two sides are intensifying their efforts to win political support among African states prior to the planned special summit meeting of the Organization of African Unity. The conference apparently will not con- vene before next month. The Military Situation Late last week, a strike force including elements of the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola and the allied National Front for the Liberation of Angola pushed the Popular Movement out of the town of Cela. A National Union communique issued on December 15 had the force moving north toward Quibala, apparently along one of the main routes leading from the south to Luanda, seat of the Popular Movement's government. The muscle of this and other combined National Union - National Front task groups is provided by un- known numbers of South African soldiers, white mercenaries, and black Angolans who fought for the Portuguese against the Popular Movement during the insurgency. In the east, the' National Union consolidated its hold on Luso, recaptured last week. Union leaders and their advisers plan to send one of their combined strike groups against Teixeira de Sousa, which like Luso has changed hands twice in the past month, and another toward Henrique base in eastern Angola. North of Luanda, the military situation has remained essentially static since Popular Move- ment forces, backed by Cuban-manned artillery, advanced two weeks ago to within about 50 miles of Ambriz, the headquarters of the Zairian-sup- ported National Front. Destruction of bridges over several rivers and the start of the rainy season have checked the Movement's drive, at least tem- porarily. Algeria, frustrated by the failure of its efforts to obtain a clear-cut dis- avowal of the tripartite agreement by the UN General Assembly last week, is strengthening its general military posture and increasing aid to Polisario Front guerrillas fighting for the in- dependence of the territory. Madrid appears to have virtually completed its evacuation of Spanish forces and civilians. Spanish press reports indicate the few remaining troops will leave in early January; a small diplomatic mission will be maintained in El Aaiun, the territorial capital. The new Spanish regime is anxious to avoid any involvement in hostilities between Morocco and the Polisario Front or its sponsor, Algeria. Moroccan army units recently arrived in El Aaiun to take up security functions. As many as 4,- 000 to 5,000 Moroccan troops reportedly are in the capital and a similar number in Semara. Some 600 Moroccan police are also stationed in El Aaiun and a few outlying towns. Several terrorist incidents occurred in El Aaiun last week. Polisario forces reportedly have considerable support among the local population in the territory, with many younger Saharans leaving the towns to join urn with the Front. Last week also brought the first reports of fighting between Mauritanian and Polisario forces, with incidents occurring at several widely separated points along the long border between Mauritania and the Saharan territory. Nouakchott has mobilized its 1,500-man army and is inducting new recruits. President Ould Daddah's govern- ment is especially concerned about protecting a vital rail line that runs parallel to the territory's southern border. In an effort to secure the rail head, Mauritanian troops, aided by a Moroccan unit that arrived by air last week, are trying to wrest control of a nearby town on the Saharan side that was occupied by Polisario forces last month. In their engagements with the Moroccans and Mauritanians, the Polisario guerrillas are now using mortars, machine guns, and grenade launchers. Each side has alleged the other is com- mitting atrocities and both are almost certainly guilty. 25X1 So long as they have Algerian backing, the guerrillas can keep up terrorist and sabotage at- tacks. The automated belt conveyor system that moves prosphate ore some 60 miles from Bu Craa to El Aaiun is especially vulnerable to guerrilla operations. Algeria, for its part, has increased its troop strength and added to its supply depots at Bechar and Tindouf, although the actual extent of the buildup is unknown. The Algerians have also ordered tents, medicine, and surgical equipment from French firms. Algeria's efforts are probably intended, for now at least, to exert psychological pressure on Morocco and to strengthen Algerian defenses along the border. Moreover, some of this activity is probably direct support of the Polisario rront. The Algae' ',ins are providing arms, training, and possibly some volunteers to the Front in the hope that the Moroccans will be bogged down fighting a long arid costly insurgency. Algiers is undoubtedly concerned over how Rabat will react to this support and wants to be ready for any contingency. 25X1 Page 6 WEEKLY SUMMARY Dec 19, 75 Declassified in Part - Sanitized Copy Approved for Release 2011/11/15: CIA-RDP86T00608R000300020054-9 Declassified in Part - Sanitized Copy Approved for Release 2011/11/15: CIA-RDP86T00608R000300020054-9 SECRET ITALY: POLITICAL MANEUVERING Italy's Christian Democratic and Socialist par- ties are both troubled by serious internal divisions as they prepare for congresses early next year. Debate will revolve around the central issue of how best to compete with the Communists in local elections this spring and in the next parliameoitary race. In the six months since the Communists near- ly outpolled the long-dominant Christian Democrats in nationwide local elections, the latter have done little to improve their prospects. The question of how to deal with the Communists has deeply divided the Christian Democrats, with the result that they were able to agree on little more than a date for the party congress at their last strategy session. The congress will open on March 4, a date acceptable to both the Christian Democratic left-led by interim party chief Zaccagni::i and Prime Minister Moro-and the opposing center- right group that is seeking to gain control of the party. The latter group, which includes a majority of the party, wanted the congress held as soon as possible, since Zaccagnini is scheduled to step down at the meeting. The center-right maintains that Zaccagnini's support for an open "dialogue" with the Communist opposition threatens to edge the Christian Democrats toward broader collaboration with them. Zaccagnini was in favor of delaying the congress until spring or later in order to consolidate the influence the party left has been gaining since he took over in July. Fearing a split that could cripple the party in the next campaign, some Christian Democrats have begun to work to bridge the gap between these two groups. Foreign Minister Rumor and Treasury Minister Colombo, for example, are part of an emerging centrist faction that is trying to put together a broadly based majority that includes all but the extreme left and extreme right in the party. The Christian Democrats' lack of progress so far, however, has helped convince the Church to take a more active role in domestic politics than it Zaccagnini has since the 1950s. Alarmed in particular by the possibility of the Communists' winning the municipal elections in Rome tllis spring, the Church hierarchy-including the Pope-is taking a harder line on the Communists. The strongest statement came this week, v.hen the Council of Italian Bishops declared that it is impossible to be Marxist and Christian at the same time. For their part, the Soc`.alists have been preoc- cupied by an internal quarrel over whether to continue their crucial parliamentary support for the Moro government. Socialist leader De Mar- tino has been under strong pressure from members of his party who believe that continued support for the government will hurt the Socialists in the next election. Last week, De Martino-while sr;arpening his criticism of the government-convinced the Socialist directorate to postpone until the party congress in February any decision on whether to end support for Moro. De Martino maintained that causing a government crisis now would play into the hands of Christian Democrats and Social Democrats who are opposing the trend in their parties toward an accomodation with the Page 7 WEEKLY SUMMARY Dec 19. 75 Declassified in Part - Sanitized Copy Approved for Release 2011/11/15: CIA-RDP86T00608R000300020054-9 Declassified in Part - Sanitized Copy Approved for Release 2011/11/15: CIA-RDP86T00608R000300020054-9 SECRET Socialists. He also agreed that a crisis in present circumstances could precipitate early parliamen- tary elections, which most political leaders oppose and for which the Socialists would be blamed. De Martino probably also wants to avoid bad publicity prior to or during his visit to the US in January. In addition, divisions among Socialists over what course to follow if Moro falls could destroy the veneer of unity that De Martino hopes to maintain through the party congress. The Communists are also urging the gover- ning parties to avoid actions that could lead to the collapse of Moro's government. Communist leaders fear that dissolution of the government now would lead to early parliamentary elections in which the central issue would be the question of Communist participation in the government. The Communists want to avoid a premature con- frontation and prefer to devote their time to con- solidating the gains they scored at the local level in June. PORTUGAL Portuguese military leaders are proceeding with a plan to reduce the armed forces' role in politics. On December 12 the Revolutionary Council announced a constitutional law forbid- ding military participation in partisan political ac- tivities. Recognizing the changing political situa- tion, the law describes the armed forces as the "guarantor" of democracy and socialism rather than as the "driving force of the revolution," the phrase often heard under former prime minister Vasco Goncalves. It also lays the groundwork for ending months of military domination of the government by relegating the armed forces to a less grandiose role. I.ip constitutional law foreshadows changes in ,greenient reached between the military and th., political parties last spring, in which the civilians agreed that the armed forces would re- tain their dominant role for the next three to five years. Since the pro-Communist regime headed by General Goncalves was overthrown in September, the political parties have demanded revisions in the pact, claiming that it no longer ac- curately represents political realities.
